approved: Taxation (Trustee Beneficiary Non-disclosure Tax) (No. 2) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

Introduced consequential tax amendments to raise the trustee beneficiary non-disclosure tax rate from 46.5 to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014, matching the increase in the Medicare levy from 1.5 to 2 per cent to fund DisabilityCare Australia.

Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
Taxation (Trustee Beneficiary Non-disclosure Tax) (No. 2) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Act 2013
